description:
💬 Tag or send this to someone who makes your life better just by being around them 👇

Your brain is shaped by your environment.

Who you spend time with is not just a social choice. It’s a neurological one.

Research in social neuroscience shows that we mirror the people around us.

Their energy, their habits, and even their mindset patterns.

So when you’re constantly surrounded by people who doubt, complain, or settle, your brain starts to normalize those behaviors.

But when you’re around people who challenge themselves, you start to rewire for expansion.

📌 Save this as a reminder to choose wisely
